newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: El Salvador sold 2.23 mln bags coffee thru Apr 10.
newsitem.headline: El Salvador sold 2.23 mln bags coffee thru Apr 10.

text.p: El Salvador exported 2.23 million 46-kilogram bags of coffee through April 10, Salvadorean Coffee Council economic analyst Tomas Bonilla said Thursday.
The country had sold about 76 percent of its exportable coffee output for about $260 million as of April 10, he told Reuters.
He said the country still has about 700,000 bags of coffee to export for the 1996-1997 coffee season.
El Salvador had exportable coffee for the season of 2.94 million bags to 3.2 million bags.
